words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.ex: I have a book.
words.en: To possess, own, or hold something.

words.ex: I will see you tomorrow day.
words.en: A day is a period of twenty-four hours, especially from twelve o'clock one night to twelve o'clock the next night.

words.tr: 用于祝愿别人度过愉快的一天，常用于告别时，中文意思为“祝你有美好的一天”
words.ex: I hope you have a good day.
words.ex_cn: 我希望你今天过得愉快。
words.en: Used to wish someone a pleasant day.

words.ex: He said bye to his friends before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前向朋友们说了再见。
words.en: A farewell remark; used to express good wishes when parting or at the end of a conversation.

words.ex: He is a good son to his parents.
words.en: A son is a male child in relation to his parents.

words.tr: n. 表兄弟（或姐妹）；堂兄弟（或姐妹）；
words.ex: My cousin plays soccer with me every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的表兄弟每周六都和我一起踢足球。
words.en: A cousin is a child of your uncle or aunt.

words.ex: My grandpa grows vegetables in his garden.
words.ex_cn: 我的姥爷在他的花园里种蔬菜。
words.en: Your grandpa is your grandfather. You can call your grandpa 'Grandpa'.

words.ex: My mom makes breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A mother; a female parent.

words.ex: My aunt bought me a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 我姨给我买了一份生日礼物。
words.en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.

words.tr: n. 祖母；外祖母；奶奶；外婆
words.ex: My grandma cooks soup every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我奶奶每个星期天都煮汤。
words.en: Your grandma is your grandmother. In other words, your grandma is your mother or father's mother.

words.ex: My dad cooks breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我爸爸每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A father; a male parent.

words.tr: n. 叔父；伯父；舅父；姑父；姨父；
words.ex: My uncle works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔父在当地一家银行工作。
words.en: The brother of someone's father or mother, or the husband of someone's aunt.

words.ex: My daughter loves to read books.
words.en: A daughter is a female child in relation to her parents.

words.ex: Here is your book.
words.en: in or at this place or position

words.ex: He took a photo of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的照片。
words.en: A photo is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: He talked of his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他谈论了他去巴黎的旅行。
words.en: You use of to combine two nouns when the first noun identifies the feature of the second noun that you want to talk about.

words.tr:
adj. 下一个的；
adv. 随后；
pron. 下一个；
words.ex: This is the next bus to the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是下一班去城市的公交车。
words.en: Coming immediately after the present one in order, sequence, or time.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.ex: The girl is playing with her dog.
words.ex_cn: 这个女孩正在和她的狗玩。
words.en: A girl is a female child or young woman.

words.ex: The dog barks loudly at night.
words.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt.

words.ex: Sally walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 萨莉每天早上走路去上学。
words.en: A sally is a sudden charge out of a besieged place against the enemy; a sortie. It can also mean a witty remark or a brief excursion or journey.

words.ex: Kate is reading a book.
words.en: A female given name, often a short form of Katherine.

words.ex: Paul is a teacher who loves math.
words.ex_cn: 保罗是一位喜欢数学的老师。
words.en: A male given name, often a short form of Paul or Pauline.

words.ex: He uses a pencil to write his name.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔写自己的名字。
words.en: A pencil is an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of wood with a rod of a black or coloured substance through the middle.

words.tr:
n. 书；账簿；
v. 预订；
words.ex: I read a book before sleep.
words.en: A book is a number of pieces of paper, usually with words printed on them, which are fastened together and fixed inside a cover of stronger paper or cardboard. Books contain information, stories, or poetry, for example.

words.ex: He used an eraser to remove the pencil mark.
words.ex_cn: 他用橡皮擦掉了铅笔印。
words.en: An eraser is a piece of rubber or other material that you use to remove pencil or pen marks from paper.

words.ex: He put the books in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进了一个箱子里。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.ex: He put his pencils in the pencil box.
words.ex_cn: 他把铅笔放进铅笔盒里。
words.en: A container used for storing pencils and other stationery items.

words.ex: He carries his schoolbag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天背着书包去学校。
words.en: A bag used by a student to carry books and other school supplies.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.ex: His book is on the table.
words.en: Used to refer to a male person or animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.ex: This book is hers.
words.en: used to refer to something belonging to or associated with a female person or animal previously mentioned

words.ex: Please excuse me for being late.
words.en: To excuse someone means to forgive them for something they have done wrong or to allow them not to do something that they should do.

words.ex: He gave the book to me.
words.en: Me is the object pronoun used to refer to oneself as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.tr: phrase. 对不起；麻烦你；打扰一下
words.ex: Excuse me, I didn't mean to bump into you.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我不是故意撞到你的。
words.en: used as a polite way to get someone's attention, to interrupt someone, or to ask someone to move so that you can pass

words.ex: I thank you for your help.
words.en: to express gratitude or appreciation to someone for something they have done

words.ex: The teacher helps students with math.
words.ex_cn: 老师帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: A teacher is a person whose job is to teach in a school or college.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；大约；大概；涉及；
adv. 大约；到处；
words.ex: The book is about animals.
words.en: If you talk about something, you are discussing it or mentioning it. If you do something about a problem, you take action to solve it.

words.ex: This book is yours.
words.en: Used to refer to something belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.tr:
prep. 为；因为；给；
conj. 因为；由于；
words.ex: I bought this gift for my mother.
words.ex_cn: 我为我妈妈买了这份礼物。
words.en: If something is for a particular person, group, or purpose, it is intended to be used by that person or group or for that purpose.

words.ex: Thank you for helping me.
words.en: A polite expression used to thank someone for something.

words.tr:
v. 帮助；
n. 帮助；
words.ex: He helps his sister with her homework.
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or information.

words.tr:
int. 欢迎；
v. 欢迎；
adj. 受欢迎的；
n. 欢迎；
words.ex: Welcome to our school!
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.ex: You're welcome.
words.en: A polite response to express gratitude, meaning 'you are appreciated for your help or kindness'.

words.ex: He plays baseball every weekend.
words.en: a game played especially in North America by two teams of nine players, in which a player hits a ball with a bat and tries to run around four bases on a large field before the other team returns the ball

words.tr:
v. 观看；观察；小心；
n. 手表；监视；注意；
words.ex: I watch TV every evening.
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.ex: He uses a computer to do his homework.
words.en: A computer is an electronic machine that can store and deal with large amounts of information.

words.ex: The children are playing a game in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩游戏。
words.en: A game is an activity or sport usually involving skill, knowledge, or chance, in which you follow fixed rules and try to win against an opponent or to solve a puzzle.

words.ex: I used my card to pay for the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 我用我的银行卡支付了杂货费用。
words.en: A card is a piece of stiff paper or thin cardboard on which something is written or printed, or a small rectangular piece of plastic containing personal data in a machine-readable form.

words.tr: phrase. 身份证；“identity card”的缩写
words.ex: He showed his id card at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的身份证。
words.en: An ID card is a card with a person's name, photograph, date of birth, and other information on it, which proves who they are.

words.ex: He writes his homework in a notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业写在笔记本里。
words.en: A notebook is a small book for writing notes in, or a small computer that is easy to carry.

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.ex: She put the apples in a bag.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果装进了一个袋子里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.ex: The book is in the bag.
words.en: Used to indicate location or position within something.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.ex: He asks me a question every day.
words.en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

words.ex: He asks for help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: To request something; to express a desire for something.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.tr:
adj. 一些；某些；
pron. 有些；若干；
words.ex: I need some water.
words.en: used to refer to an unspecified amount or number of something

words.ex: The students are sitting in the classroom.
words.en: A room in a school where lessons take place.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.ex: He threw the ball at the window.
words.en: You use at to indicate the place or event where something happens or is situated.

words.tr:
v. 叫；打电话；
n. 打电话；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.en: If you call someone, you telephone them. If you call someone a particular name or title, you give them that name or title. If you call a meeting, you arrange for it to take place. If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: adj. 丢失的； v. 丢失；输；“lose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The lost keys were found under the table.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙在桌子下面找到了。
words.en: If you are lost, you do not know where you are or you are unable to find your way.

words.tr:
auxv. 必须；一定要；
n. 必须做的事；必不可少的事物；
words.ex: You must finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你必须在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is very likely or certain to be true or to happen.

words.tr:
v. 设置；使固定；放置；
n. 一组；一套；
adj. 固定的；位于…的；安排好的；
words.ex: He set the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他把闹钟设在早上六点。
words.en: To put something in a specified place or position; to adjust or arrange something; a group of things that belong together or are used together; fixed or established.

words.ex: He has a set of books on the shelf.
words.en: A group of similar things that belong together or are used together.

words.ex: Anna is my sister.
words.en: A female given name.

words.tr: n. 约翰（男性名）；俚语指厕所；
words.ex: John is my best friend.
words.en: A male given name.

words.ex: David is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 大卫正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A male given name, derived from the Hebrew name דָּוִד (Dāwīḏ), meaning 'beloved'.

words.ex: Where is the book?
words.en: You use where to ask questions about the place or position of someone or something, or to indicate the place or position of someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 桌子；表格；台子；
v. 搁置；
words.ex: He put his books on the table.
words.en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or use to do things such as eat, write, or work.

words.ex: He sleeps on a soft bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡在一张柔软的床上。
words.en: A bed is a piece of furniture that you lie on when you sleep.

words.ex: The bookcase is full of storybooks.
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.ex: He sits on the sofa every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都坐在沙发上。
words.en: A sofa is a long, comfortable seat with a back and usually with arms, which two or three people can sit on.

words.ex: He sat on the chair and read a book.
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: He is on the bus.
words.en: used to indicate position above and in contact with a surface, or to indicate the topic of discussion, or to indicate the time when something happens, or to indicate the means by which something is done, or to indicate the basis for something, or to indicate the state of something

words.ex: The cat is under the table.
words.en: In or to a position below or beneath something.

words.ex: Please come to my house tomorrow.
words.en: To move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker; to arrive at a place; to happen or take place.

words.tr: phrase. 加油；快点；拜托；来吧；开始
words.ex: Come on, you can finish this race!
words.ex_cn: 加油，你能跑完这场比赛的！
words.en: Used to encourage someone to do something or to hurry up, or to express disbelief or skepticism.

words.ex: He does his homework at the desk.
words.en: A desk is a piece of furniture with a flat surface, typically used for writing, reading, or working on a computer.

words.ex: I think it is a good idea.
words.en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or idea about someone or something.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.tr: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的；
words.ex: Their books are on the table.
words.en: You use their to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

words.ex: He wears a black hat every day.
words.en: A hat is a head covering which is worn for various reasons, including protection against weather conditions, ceremonial reasons such as university graduation, religious reasons, safety, or as a fashion accessory.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.ex: Do you like pizza? Yeah.
words.en: used to give an affirmative response

words.ex: I know the answer.
words.en: To have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.ex: He looks at the clock every hour.
words.en: A clock is an instrument that shows the time, usually in hours and minutes.

words.tr: n. 磁带；录音带；胶带；带子；
words.ex: He recorded the song on a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首歌录在磁带上。
words.en: A tape is a narrow strip of plastic or other material that is used for recording sound or pictures, or for sticking things together.

words.tr: n. 运动员；选手；唱机；玩家；
words.ex: The player scored a goal in the final minute.
words.ex_cn: 这名运动员在最后一分钟进了一球。
words.en: A player is someone who takes part in a game or sport, or someone who performs in a theatrical production or musical performance.

words.tr: phrase. 磁带播放器；录音机
words.ex: He listens to music on a tape player.
words.ex_cn: 他用磁带播放器听音乐。
words.en: A tape player is a device that plays sound recordings on magnetic tape.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: The plane landed safely at the airport.
words.en: A plane is a vehicle designed for air travel that has wings and one or more engines.

words.ex: He built a model plane for his school project.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校的项目做了一个飞机模型。
words.en: A small aircraft made for display or as a hobby, often built from a kit.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.ex: Our dog sleeps on the floor.
words.en: Belonging to or associated with the speaker and one or more other people previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr: adv. 到处；处处；各个地方；所有地方；
words.ex: She looked everywhere for her keys.
words.en: in or to all places

words.ex: He always eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: At all times; on all occasions.

words.ex: I do my homework every evening.
words.en: To perform or accomplish something

words.ex: I have a book.
words.en: To possess, own, or hold something.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: The boy kicked the ball into the net.
words.en: A ball is a round object that is used in games such as soccer, baseball, and basketball. It can also refer to a formal dance.

words.ex: He plays ping-pong after school.
words.en: Ping-pong is a game played on a table with small bats and a light ball. The players hit the ball back and forth over a net.

words.ex: A bat flew out of the cave at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝙蝠在晚上从洞穴里飞了出来。
words.en: A bat is a piece of wood used to hit the ball in games such as cricket, baseball, and table tennis. It can also refer to a small animal that flies at night.

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.tr: phrase. 足球（用于英式足球比赛的球）
words.ex: He kicked the soccer ball into the goal.
words.en: A soccer ball is the ball used in the game of soccer, typically made of leather or similar material and filled with air.

words.ex: He plays volleyball every Saturday.
words.en: A game played by two teams of six players in which a large ball is hit by hand over a high net, the aim being to score points by making the ball reach the ground on the opponent's side of the court.

words.ex: He plays basketball every weekend.
words.en: A game played between two teams of five players in which goals are scored by throwing a ball through a netted hoop fixed above each end of the court.

words.ex: Hey, can you help me with this?
words.en: used to attract attention or to express surprise, interest, or annoyance

words.ex: Let me help you with your homework.
words.en: To allow or permit something to happen or someone to do something.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一次测验。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.tr: abbr. 让我们；“let us”的缩写
words.ex: Let's go to the park.
words.en: Used to introduce a suggestion or a proposal.

words.ex: Let us go to the park.
words.en: used to make a suggestion or to ask for permission to do something

words.ex: He goes to school every day.
words.en: To move or travel from one place to another.

words.ex: We are eating lunch now.
words.en: We is the first person plural pronoun used by a speaker or writer to refer to themselves and one or more other people considered together.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.ex: She has a red book.
words.en: Used with the third person singular present tense of 'have'.

words.tr: v. 得到；获得；使；变得；收到；
words.ex: I got a new book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我从图书馆得到了一本新书。
words.en: To come into possession of something; to receive or be given something.

words.tr:
adj. 极好的；大的；伟大的；
adv. 很好地；
words.ex: This is a great movie!
words.en: If you describe someone or something as great, you approve of them or admire them.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；

words.en: If you are busy, you are working hard or giving your attention to a particular activity.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.tr: 短语. 玩得愉快；过得开心
words.ex: We have a good time at the park.
words.ex_cn: 我们在公园玩得很开心。
words.en: To enjoy oneself; to experience pleasure or enjoyment.

words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.en: Used to indicate the place where someone or something is or where something happens.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.tr: abbr. 体育教育；“physical education”的缩写
words.ex: He plays basketball in p.e. class.
words.en: Physical Education, a subject in school that involves physical activities and sports.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.ex: He likes math because it is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它很简单。
words.en: Math is the study of numbers, quantities, and shapes.

words.tr:
adj. 中国的；
n. 中国人；汉语；
words.ex: She ate Chinese food for dinner.
words.en: Of or relating to China, its people, or their languages.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.ex: Why did you come late?
words.en: You use why in questions when you ask about the reasons for something.

words.ex: He was late because the bus was slow.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车很慢。
words.en: You use 'because' when stating the reason for something.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Monday.
words.en: Monday is the day of the week between Sunday and Tuesday.

words.ex: I will go to the park on Friday.
words.en: Friday is the day of the week between Thursday and Saturday.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.tr: phrase. 肯定地；毫无疑问地
words.ex: He will come for sure.
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.tr:
adj. 凉爽的；酷的；凉的；顶好的；
v. 变凉；
words.ex: The water is cool after the rain.
words.en: If you say that a person or their behavior is cool, you mean that they are calm and unemotional, especially in a difficult situation.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Tuesday.
words.en: Tuesday is the day of the week following Monday and preceding Wednesday.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 我在星期三有一个会议。
words.en: Wednesday is the day of the week that comes after Tuesday and before Thursday.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Thursday.
words.en: Thursday is the day of the week between Wednesday and Friday.

words.ex: We go to the park on Sunday.
words.en: Sunday is the day of the week following Saturday and preceding Monday.

words.tr: abbr. 上午；午前；“ante meridiem”的缩写
words.ex: He wakes up at 6 a.m. every day.
words.en: used when referring to a time between midnight and noon

words.tr: abbr. 下午；午后；“post meridiem”的缩写
words.ex: The meeting starts at 3 p.m.
words.en: Used after a time to indicate that it is in the afternoon or evening.

words.ex: This tool is useful for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具对解决数学问题很有用。
words.en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

words.ex: He walks from school to home.
words.en: Indicating the point in space at which a journey, motion, or action starts.

words.tr: 介词短语，表示从某个起点到某个终点，可用于时间、地点、数量、范围等
words.ex: The store is open from nine to five.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店从九点开到五点。
words.en: Indicating the starting point and the ending point of a range or movement.

words.ex: Mrs. Brown teaches English at the school.
words.ex_cn: 布朗夫人在学校教英语。
words.en: A title used before a married woman's surname or full name.

words.ex: He will finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他会在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish something means to reach the end of it or to complete it.

words.ex: I have math lesson every Monday.
words.en: A lesson is a period of time in which someone is taught about a particular subject or how to do something.

words.ex: She completed a 675-hour training program.
words.ex_cn: 她完成了一个675小时的培训项目。
words.en: An hour is a period of sixty minutes.
